title: How a Mom of 3 Makes $50K a Month With AI (No Experience)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest promotes her YouTube channel, app and Skool community

idea.name: AI-powered SEO/blog automation freelancing via Upwork
idea.one_liner: Apply to adjacent non-'AI' Upwork niches (e.g. SEO) with a Loom pitch of a ChatGPT-designed n8n workflow, then deliver blog automation with Claude Code on retainer
idea.customer: SMBs such as a ~$1M education app business

key_quotes.quote: I didn't type AI SEO. I only typed SEO.
you are going to record a video loom video explaining how you can help them and that's exactly what I did.
So, I pitch the idea before I build a product.

claims.claim: First Upwork job after 7 applications paid $3k/month
claims.quote: And her first job she got after seven applications and it paid her $3,000 a month for SEO and she knew nothing about SEO

claims.claim: Raised retainer to $5.5k by expanding to more languages
claims.quote: So after that I increased the price to 5.5k monthly retainer same client.

claims.claim: Client work takes about an hour a day
claims.quote: Even the client work, I only spend like an hour a day maximum.

ideas.delivery: n8n workflows and Claude Code automating blog content in English, Japanese, Spanish, Korean

idea.name: Build-in-public AI YouTube personal brand
idea.one_liner: YouTube channel teaching AI builds, monetised through sponsors, AdSense, a Skool community and inbound consulting
idea.customer: aspiring AI builders and brands wanting sponsorships
idea.offer: tutorial videos, paid community, sponsorships, consulting

key_quotes.quote: But ever since I started my personal branding content, people were reaching out to me.
And here's another tip that I have for people, which is if you don't know anything what you're going to film, you learn right before.

claims.quote: So, you're making over 50,000 a month.
This is all inbound. Sponsorships is everything is inbound.

acquisition_channels.details: viral build videos, e.g. selling AI websites with Claude Code

ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP rules require sponsored content to be clearly labelled as ads

idea.name: All-in-one YouTube script/thumbnail/teleprompter app
idea.one_liner: App that copies outlier-video strategies to generate scripts, thumbnails and teleprompter, built after a viral video revealed demand
idea.revenue_model: paid app subscriptions; lead magnet for community

key_quotes.quote: But what this does is you're trying to copy the strategy that other people use from YouTube videos.

ideas.delivery: built with Claude Code, now maintained by a hired engineer

idea.name: GEO (AI search) audit app
idea.one_liner: App built in six hours on camera that audits a site's generative engine optimisation, i.e. AI SEO

key_quotes.quote: I sold the idea first and then saw what is needed and then build a product after.
